name: Rupture
description: Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your attack power.  Lasts longer per combo point:   1 point  : 176 damage over 8 secs   2 points: 255 damage over 10 secs   3 points: 348 damage over 12 secs   4 points: 455 damage over 14 secs   5 points: 576 damage over 16 secs
